p6.title: https://nycasinos.ny.gov/system/files/documents/2025/09/final-cac-responses-9.29.25-1-c.pdf
p6.excerpt: As discussed in our Application (see EvalEconCaliber5.HardRock.RetailRecOther), HRMP will unlock further development potential within Metropolitan Park by delivering a parking podium on which Queens Baseball Company (i.e., the New York Mets) will then build the Taste of Queens. Detailed design for the interior of the Taste of Queens is still underway. We currently anticipate that the market (“food hall”) will be located on the elevated first floor, directly accessible and visible from the MTA gateway plaza as well as the open space. The market will accommodate approximately 20 local food vendors, and we plan to partner with local groups to ensure that includes a mix of operators coming from both brick-and-mortar and street vendor origins. We look forward to working with our community partners on further programmatic details in the years ahead before grand opening.
